data.name: Manahil
data.gender_notes: Manahil is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Manahil means 'traveler' or 'resting place'. It is derived from the root 'n-h-l', which carries the concept of movement or journey. The name Manahil carries the meaning “Traveler” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Manahil usually hope their child will grow to embody traveler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Hadith, Manahil is mentioned as one of the seven gates of Paradise, where the believers will find peace and rest.
data.etymology: Manahil belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Traveler.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Manahil total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: مناهل
in_arabic.long_meaning: مناهل هي المَناهل المِن شَرع الله تعالى، وهي المَناهل المُرتبطة بالدعاء، والصلاة، والتوجيه، والمساعدة، والمعرفة، والتواصل. وتُعد مناهل من أهم العِبادات في الإسلام، حيث أنها تُعتبر وسيلة للاقتراب من الله تعالى، وتُعتبر أيضاً وسيلة لحث النفس على الصالحات، وتُعتبر أيضاً وسيلة للتحقق من صحة النفس، وتُعتبر أيضاً وسيلة للتعرف على ذات الله تعالى

in_urdu.name: مناهل
in_urdu.meaning: منانہل جو چاہئیں، جو مقصود ہیں، وہ دلچسپی
in_urdu.long_meaning: منانہل اسلامی اصطلاح میں جو چاہئیں، جو مقصود ہیں، وہ دلچسپی، وہ مطلوبات ہیں جو اللہ تعالیٰ کی طرف سے ہوتی ہیں۔ منانہل کے تحت دعا، نماز، توجہ، مدد، علم اور رابطہ شامل ہیں۔ یہ اسلامی اصطلاحات کے لحاظ سے منانہل کا اہم کردار ہے جس سے مسلمانوں کو اللہ تعالیٰ کے قربت میں لے جانے میں مدد ملتی ہے اور صلاحیتوں کو بہتر بنانے کے لئے حوصلہ افزائی ملتی ہے۔

in_hindi.name: मनाहिल
in_hindi.meaning: जो चाहिए, जो लालच, जो लालसा
in_hindi.long_meaning: मनाहिल उस मनाहिल को कहते हैं जो इस्लामी नियम के अनुसार होती हैं, जो अल्लाह की ओर से होती हैं। मनाहिल में दुआ, नमाज, ध्यान, मदद, ज्ञान और संपर्क शामिल हैं। यह इस्लामी धर्म के मंत्रों में से एक महत्वपूर्ण है जिससे मुसलमान अल्लाह के करीब आने में मदद पाते हैं और अपनी क्षमताओं को बेहतर बनाने के लिए प्रेरित होते हैं।

in_english.name: Manahil
in_english.long_meaning: Manahil refers to the wishes, aspirations, desires, and prayers that are ordained by Allah in Islam. In Islamic tradition, manahil encompasses the acts of worship, such as dua, salah, and istikhara. It is considered a means of drawing closer to Allah and of cultivating good character. The concept of manahil is rooted in the Quranic verse "And hasten to forgiveness from your Lord, and a garden as wide as the heavens and the earth" (Quran 3:133).

data.cultural_impact: The name Manahil holds a deep cultural significance, particularly in the Islamic tradition. In this context, it is often used as a title for Prophet Moses' wife, Asiyah, who according to several Hadiths, was known as 'Manahil Al-Tha'labah', meaning a 'journeying woman' or 'woman of journey'. She was the daughter of Pharaoh Shu'ayb, the companion of Prophet Moses (peace be upon him). The name highlights her constant movement and lifelong determination to support her husband's spiritual journey.
data.spiritual_significance: Manahil holds a rich spiritual significance in Islam. It is a reminder that life itself is a spiritual journey - one filled with trials, challenges, and ultimately, growth. The name Manahil can be seen as a reflection of the spiritual traveler, constantly moving on his path to success in this world and the hereafter, seeking knowledge and nearness to God.
